name: Sync Data X-Ray Classifications
description: Started from Collibra's global Create menu: confirms the action on a start form, runs the Data X-Ray-to-Collibra classification sync (classifications, annotators, extractors, labels), then shows a results form with per-category counts and any failures. All connection settings (Data X-Ray URL, auth token, domain and asset/attribute type IDs) remain hidden admin configuration on the workflow settings page.
